description: An older man with grey hair, in a dark frock coat and cravat, sits at a wooden desk in a dimly lit room. He holds a small brass balance scale with gold coins on one pan, with more coins scattered on the desk. A lit candle, a stack of old leather-bound books, an open ornate box, inkwells and a quill sit beside him. The painting is dark, warm and oil-like, filling the whole image with no visible frame or text.
